question: Which celebrity feud just refuses to die?
story: Blake Lively just sent Justin Baldoni a bill for eight million dollars, and the wildest part? Their lawsuit is already over. Quick recap. They starred in It Ends With Us together. She accused him of harassment on set. He fired back with a defamation suit. It got ugly. Then in May they finally settled, no trial, and get this, nobody paid anybody a single dollar. Everyone thought it was done. Wrong. Weeks later, Lively's lawyers asked the judge to make Baldoni cover her legal fees. Eight million dollars worth. And on Monday, Baldoni's team fired back in court, calling the bill excessive, and pointing out her lawyers billed over seven thousand hours using eighty-two different people. Eighty-two lawyers. For a trial that never happened. The movie was a romance. The lawsuit is the sequel.
